checks.description: current_context_pack and machine-readable ledgers must be available before expensive runs.

No open full_chain_blocker root-cause rows for the requested run_scope unless the run is explicitly diagnostic and user-approved. Scope-specific blockers can keep broad/release eval blocked while allowing a controlled single-case proof.

Before every provider/model node, record a task-specific TokenBudgetBasis covering mission, input inventory, required outputs, schema burden, materiality and quality risk, comparable usage evidence, reasoning profile, headroom, and stop/truncation semantics. Cost and latency are secondary and required research work cannot be silently removed to meet a cap.

Confirm the bound provider profile, unread credential presence, and either a recent complete capture or an explicitly budgeted connectivity/auth probe. A separate probe is not mandatory when it would add a non-research paid call and recent immutable evidence is valid.

Cases requiring dynamic retrieval cannot be validated with dry-run evidence operators. A reviewed fixed Evidence Pack is valid only when the decision labels the run as a model-analysis unit test and forbids any Agentic Research or product claim.

A run claiming complete real-chain or product qualification requires the S1 source/capture, OCR/parser/cleaning, chunk/object, index, query/route, recall, rerank, finance-aware fine-rank, Evidence admission, Coverage/gap, heterogeneous holdout, and stability qualification to pass. Narrow deterministic, shadow, or node canaries may proceed only when explicitly labeled diagnostic and cannot claim S1 or full-chain product acceptance.

Known evidence, data, and research-quality blockers must either be outside the exact decision-bound run scope or explicitly allow that scope; a narrow allowance must not be projected to dynamic research, a five-cell case, publication, or release.
